$comment: Canonical source for the AI-groundedness/plausibility gate — one of the shared pieces the flow-harness proposal (drive-curation/Flow_Harness_Extraction_Proposal_2026-09-10.md, Phase 0) and the redundancy review both identified: three independently-built implementations (cas-ccps/scripts/37_FlowInputBuilder.js's _fiCheckPlausibility_, leader-hub/EmailBridge.gs's _checkAiResultPlausible_, kos-personal/12_StudioReturnHarvest.gs's _srCheckGroundedness_) had already drifted from each other before this file existed — cas-ccps caught 'could not open' and leader-hub didn't; leader-hub caught 'insufficient context' and cas-ccps didn't; kos-personal had no phrase list at all. GAS gives each system its own execution scope, so the runtime CODE stays three separate implementations (see the proposal's own scope line: input construction and output routing stay module-specific, permanently) — only this data is unified. tools/flow-harness-sync/sync-plausibility-phrases.js materializes it into all three at build time; tools/gas-lint/check.js's harness-drift check fails the build if any of the three ever stops matching what this file would generate.
